# Gaps between Chapter 5's migration severity for EK4402 and the compiler,
# found by FuzzPlatformHatchSymbols. Chapter 5 makes EK4402 a warning in a
# formerly accepted sync, callback, Effect.try or Effect.tryPromise callback,
# and Appendix B reports host clock and randomness reads as EK4402 by resolved
# host origin. The compiler warns for console, setTimeout, localStorage,
# navigator and fetch in those callbacks but keeps clock and randomness reads
# errors. A key names the host access; <symbol>/hatch covers every wrapper
# form (arrow, block, function, options object) and host (effect function,
# plain function, top-level const).
# target                  key                                   owner     what is missing
